fusions.name: Placid Regard
fusions.desc: A level look across a cone 4 tiles long deals 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Stare
fusions.desc: Fixes a target up to 8 tiles away for 26 damage that ignores armour, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and leaves it moving 30% slower for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Glassed Over
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clear Water Sight
fusions.desc: Your water damage cannot be resisted, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
